# omicsApp

Shiny web interface for multi-omics analysis, built on
[`omicsCore`](https://puweilin.github.io/omicsApp/omicsCore).

## Install

``` r

# Install dependencies first
devtools::install_local("path/to/omicsCore")
devtools::install_local("path/to/omicsApp")
```

## Launch

``` r

omicsApp::launch()
```

## Status

Phase 0 — skeleton. The UI modules and server logic will be implemented
in Phase 2.

# Package index

## App entry point

Launch the application

- [`omicsApp`](https://puweilin.github.io/omicsApp/omicsApp/reference/omicsApp-package.md)
  [`omicsApp-package`](https://puweilin.github.io/omicsApp/omicsApp/reference/omicsApp-package.md)
  : omicsApp: Shiny Web Interface for Multi-Omics Analysis
- [`launch()`](https://puweilin.github.io/omicsApp/omicsApp/reference/launch.md)
  : Launch the omicsApp Shiny application
